page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (faint, partly cut off) and right margin (small, italic). Running head at top centre; page number top right; a centred small-caps heading "CONTEMPORANEA" in the middle of the page.

main_text.p: Altero post anno ... Hanc ... morbus ... Imperavit annos ... menses X, dies XXIX.
main_text.head: Contemporanea.
main_text.p: Apud PARTHOS nihil omnino occurrit. Bellum Alanis qui Mallagetæ, Pharasmanes mo-vit. Mediamque vexata Armenia & Cappadocia, vastavit. Multamen Alani seu Vologæsi munerib[us] ... Flavii Arriani Cappadociæ præfecti merunt conquievere.
De AFRICA non habeo, quod scribam: præter id, quod de reliquiis Pompeji sepulchro accurrebat.

Apud SVECOS fuccessit Sivardo Carolus: Quem excepit Ericus, Sivardi ex filia nepos, In GERMANIA, SICAMBRIS imperavit Hi[ldeb]ert Oidemarum [illegible, ~6 letters] Ibidem à Granio Severo exstructum est quod sa-cerdotibus aquis nunc clarescit.

In HISPANIA Adrianus ædem Augusti Tarraconensem restituit, omnibusque Hispanis in cavernam vocatis, de iocularitèr de Italicis, vehementissimè cœterus, ... Adriano, ... & caute conluluit. Ibidem furiosi cujusdam maritus vix evasit, comprehensum medi-cum.
BRITANNIÆ præfectus Iulius Severus, & in Armenia per LXXXM palluum, quidem Rotomagus dividere, duxit, qui valde sinceram [illegible, ~3 letters].

page.notes: Left margin notes are largely illegible. Right margin notes read approximately "Asiatica", "Africa", "Europa", "Spartianus", "Adriano", "Mart. in Hist. Aug." and "Maur. Gallus"; the scan is faint and damaged, so these are uncertain. Many words in the body are doubtful, especially near the left edge and in the lower paragraphs, and several lines are partly obscured by show-through. Transcription is approximate where marked by context.
